mission.title: So Much Stress, Such a Busy Life

theory.title: So y such en oraciones consecutivas
theory.explanation: Usa so + adjetivo/adverbio y such + (a/an) + adjetivo + sustantivo. Añade that + oración para expresar el resultado: It was so tiring that I fell asleep (estaba tan cansado que me dormí); It was such a busy day that I forgot lunch (fue un día tan ajetreado que olvidé comer).

patterns.label: So y such en oraciones consecutivas · 1
patterns.pattern: The workout was so difficult that I had to stop.
examples:
The workout was so difficult that I had to stop.
→ El entrenamiento fue tan difícil que tuve que parar.

patterns.label: So y such en oraciones consecutivas · 2
patterns.pattern: It was such a busy day that I forgot lunch.
examples:
It was such a busy day that I forgot lunch.
→ Fue un día tan ajetreado que me olvidé de comer.

patterns.label: So y such en oraciones consecutivas · 3
patterns.pattern: She was so tired that she went to bed early.
examples:
She was so tired that she went to bed early.
→ Estaba tan cansada que se acostó temprano.

patterns.label: So y such en oraciones consecutivas · 4
patterns.pattern: It was such an interesting class that I joined again.
examples:
It was such an interesting class that I joined again.
→ Fue una clase tan interesante que volví a apuntarme.

patterns.label: So y such en oraciones consecutivas · 5
patterns.pattern: The instructions were so clear that everyone understood.
examples:
The instructions were so clear that everyone understood.
→ Las instrucciones eran tan claras que todo el mundo las entendió.

patterns.label: So y such en oraciones consecutivas · 6
patterns.pattern: He had such a bad headache that he stayed home.
examples:
He had such a bad headache that he stayed home.
→ Tenía un dolor de cabeza tan fuerte que se quedó en casa.

patterns.label: So y such en oraciones consecutivas · 7
patterns.pattern: The music was so loud that we couldn't talk.
examples:
The music was so loud that we couldn't talk.
→ La música estaba tan alta que no podíamos hablar.

patterns.label: So y such en oraciones consecutivas · 8
patterns.pattern: It was such good advice that I wrote it down.
examples:
It was such good advice that I wrote it down.
→ Fue un consejo tan bueno que lo apunté.

patterns.label: So y such en oraciones consecutivas · 9
patterns.pattern: They were so relaxed that they nearly fell asleep.
examples:
They were so relaxed that they nearly fell asleep.
→ Estaban tan relajados que casi se quedaron dormidos.

patterns.label: So y such en oraciones consecutivas · 10
patterns.pattern: It was such a long walk that we needed a rest.
examples:
It was such a long walk that we needed a rest.
→ Fue un paseo tan largo que necesitamos descansar.

content.passage: The wellness centre organised such an interesting workshop that it quickly became popular. The first activity was so relaxing that many people asked to repeat it. The instructor gave such clear advice that everyone could follow the exercises. Some participants were so tired afterwards that they went home early. It was such a positive experience that the centre plans to organise another session next month.

items.prompt: Describe an activity that was so difficult you had to stop.
items.modelAnswer: I think looking after your health is about building realistic habits and making balanced choices. I try to stay active, drink enough water and get regular sleep. When I feel stressed, I take a break or go for a walk. It is important to follow medical advice and ask questions when something is unclear. Small changes can make a big difference over time, especially when people keep practising them.

content.audioTranscript: A: Have you got your appointment tomorrow? B: Yes, I want to talk about my daily routine. A: Are you doing enough exercise? B: I'm trying to. The doctor gave me some useful advice. A: What did they suggest? B: Drinking more water and getting enough sleep. A: Do you need any medicine? B: No, but I need to rest during my recovery. A: I hope you feel better by tomorrow.
